people.name: Meholathites
people.line: People from Abel-meholah, including Adriel and Barzillai.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.
translations.bsb: So when it was time to give Saul’s daughter Merab to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah.
translations.kjv: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
translations.asv: But it came to pass at the time when Merab, Saul's daughter, should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
